purpose: Optional recognition for attributable, verified contributions to useful work without buying status, manufacturing prestige or converting reputation into scientific/governance authority.
owner_relation: CoFree+ publication commons recognition; CoLivingHighlight+ stable IDs; CoReviewSpine+ evidence; CoBeacon+ public discovery. No new award control plane.

recognition_classes.name: Repeatable proof
recognition_classes.promise: A finding or experiment someone else can reproduce
recognition_classes.evidence: Public or permission-cleared test protocol, exact source/version, scoped result and independent reproduction when independence is claimed

recognition_classes.name: Repair and recovery
recognition_classes.promise: Makes something broken, confusing or unsafe reliably better
recognition_classes.evidence: Before/after evidence, regression test, rollback path and affected receiver result

recognition_classes.name: Courageous correction
recognition_classes.promise: Finds an error or better explanation that improves shared understanding
recognition_classes.evidence: Specific counterexample, civil critique, source-bound correction and acknowledgement of uncertainty
recognition_classes.example: Identifies a misleading claim without targeting a person

recognition_classes.name: Access and inclusion
recognition_classes.promise: Makes a useful experience accessible to more kinds of people
recognition_classes.evidence: Consent-based accessibility testing, legible alternative, named improvement and reviewer results
recognition_classes.example: Caption, transcript and screen reader parity

recognition_classes.name: Teaching that works
recognition_classes.promise: Turns something difficult into something another person can actually understand or do
recognition_classes.evidence: Learning objective, lesson artifact, consented independent learner observation and limitations

recognition_classes.name: Creative clarity
recognition_classes.promise: Original art, diagrams, audio, video or interactive design that increases understanding
recognition_classes.evidence: Rights and attribution, source-to-media fidelity, caption/alt accessible twin, independent comprehension
recognition_classes.example: A short film that explains a working demo without overclaim

recognition_classes.name: Open and reusable work
recognition_classes.promise: A reproducible tool or method that helps others retain choice and exit
recognition_classes.evidence: License, build/run recipe, safety boundaries, portable source and an independent reuse or restoration case

recognition_classes.name: Helpful connection
recognition_classes.promise: Links useful work across communities, platforms or languages without capturing people
recognition_classes.evidence: Documented interoperable result, consent/permissions, failure handling and measured receiver value
recognition_classes.example: A standards-based learning edition usable elsewhere

recognition_classes.name: Continuity and care
recognition_classes.promise: Preserves work, history, privacy and recovery when people or tools change
recognition_classes.evidence: Versioned provenance, recovery/exit proof, non-destructive handoff and consent from affected parties

recognition_classes.name: Pay-it-forward contribution
recognition_classes.promise: Freely shares knowledge, time or capability with practical benefit and no coercion
recognition_classes.evidence: Voluntary recipient account or objective outcome, transparent rights, no quid-pro-quo and no personal data disclosed
recognition_classes.example: A free accessible kit successfully reused

recognition_classes.name: Resource-wise innovation
recognition_classes.promise: Achieves equal or greater useful outcome with less waste or risk
recognition_classes.evidence: Baseline, measured latency/energy/cost or other resource, honest uncertainty and quality parity

recognition_classes.name: Useful alternative
recognition_classes.promise: Expands the option space with an unexpected, testable better path
recognition_classes.evidence: Clear baseline, alternative, discriminating test, negative-result policy and observed incremental benefit
recognition_classes.example: A counterproposal that performs better on a real task

stages.requires: Any voluntary source-linked suggestion; not a public credential
Named work and explicit non-sensitive evidence; recipient notified only through authorized channels
Rights, conflicts, authority, exact artifact version and criteria checked
Documented independent or transparently disclosed panel review; dissent preserved
Recipient explicitly opts in to the name/attribution and publication of recognition
Real accountable issuer, stable dated criteria, exact evidence pointers, public effect receipt and correction/revocation route
Visible correction, withdrawal or privacy-safe archival/tombstone as required; do not silently erase dispute

operational_policy.self_nominations: May propose a candidate, but never score or approve own nomination
operational_policy.fictional_or_symbolic_awards: CLEARLY_LABELED; NO EMPIRICAL OR PROFESSIONAL STATUS

anti_capture: No ranking truth by fame, payment, followers, political/religious identity, donations or inferred traits
Celebrate overlooked and quiet contributions, including error correction and refused awards
Separate science/engineering evidence from creative, cultural, philosophical and symbolic merit
No award confers access rights, product release, governance role, endorsement or scientific proof
Require conflict disclosure, protected decline, accessible nomination and visible appeals
Do not send bulk nomination invitations or scrape personal/credential data
Do not use awards to incentivize spam, compulsive engagement, financial risk or false urgency
